description: This is a PHP source file defining the RoundCommand class, which implements a console command to manage and transition project rounds/statuses in a crowdfunding platform. It includes command configuration, execution logic for processing project statuses, handling different project rounds, refunding investments, and predicting project outcomes.

classes.name: RoundCommand
classes.description: Defines a console command for managing project rounds, including configuration, execution, project status transitions, refunds, and predictive assessments.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution logic for processing projects' rounds, including status checks, predictions, and refunds.

methods.name: refundProject
methods.description: Handles the refund process for a project by executing a subcommand.
